scripts.preinstall: cd ../../packages/sdk && rm -rf dist tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json && test -f dist/index.js && echo 'SDK build OK'
scripts.build:sdk: cd ../../packages/sdk && rm -rf dist tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.ensure:sdk: test -f ../../packages/sdk/dist/index.js || (echo '@nyx/sdk dist missing - rebuilding' && npm run build:sdk) && test -f ../../packages/sdk/dist/index.js
